titulo_fr: Un courriel personnel : Repérer les informations
intro: It follows the reason for a mail and distinguishes a request, explanation and proposal for a reply. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It follows the reason for a mail and distinguishes a request, explanation and proposal for a reply. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
Attention point: The courtesy conditional softens a request; the connectors explain why another date is proposed. In this fragment, «disponibilité» means «disponibilidad».

frases.fr: Bonjour Claire, pourrais-tu me confirmer ta disponibilité pour le week-end du 12 ?
frases.es: Hola, Claire: ¿podrías confirmarme si estás disponible el fin de semana del 12?
frases.en: Hey, Claire, could you confirm if you're available on the weekend of 12?

frases.fr: Je voudrais réserver la salle avant jeudi, car le tarif augmente ensuite.
frases.es: Quisiera reservar la sala antes del jueves porque después sube la tarifa.
frases.en: I'd like to book the room before Thursday because then the rate goes up.
